definitions.gloss: separated; apart from one another; scattered
definitions.explanation: The state of people (or things) who were once together being apart and unable to be together. Most often used of family or close friends who become separated.

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}が{離|はな}れ{離|ばな}れになる。
{戦争|せんそう}で{親子|おやこ}が{離|はな}れ{離|ばな}れになった。
examples.english: Parent and child were separated by the war.

examples.japanese: {進学|しんがく}で{友人|ゆうじん}たちと{離|はな}れ{離|ばな}れになったが、{今|いま}も{連絡|れんらく}は{取|と}り{合|あ}っている。
examples.english: I was separated from my friends when we went on to different schools, but we still keep in touch.

notes:
Formed by reduplicating {離|はな}れる (to be apart); the second {離|はな}れ voices to ばなれ. Almost always appears with なる or に, as in {離|はな}れ{離|ばな}れになる.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {離|はな}れ{離|ばな}れになる: to become separated
- {離|はな}れ{離|ばな}れに{暮|く}らす: to live apart
- {家族|かぞく}が{離|はな}れ{離|ばな}れ: a family scattered apart

USAGE:
Carries an emotional, often sad nuance of people who wish to be together but cannot be.
